subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

MAP : NZK :: HOZ:SLA :: WQK : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Opposite letter according to English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• MAP : NZK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c4dbd9f0b809e0b914dfaee7fabdd88e864ea8b9c3a2f4274c4c850027cc0fd.png] 

And,

 
• HOZ:SLA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d22022196e6f2978f9f154dca3a41c47ccae4bcb4458c2a18167400ef4b5b83c.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• WQK : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27ca8a84bbd28acda3c6eac70b65639355d82ddedc96ed08fb58a2c78ff06ea8.png] 

​Hence, "**DJP**" is the correct answer.
